_meta.source: Mock CVE intelligence database for the VulnTriage POC.
_meta.note: Hand-curated snapshot of well-known CVEs. Scores follow NVD CVSS v3.x. Replace with a live NVD / CISA KEV feed — see FUTURE_ADDONS.md items 2 and 3.

CVE-2021-44228.name: Log4Shell
CVE-2021-44228.description: Apache Log4j2 JNDI features used in configuration, log messages and parameters do not protect against attacker-controlled LDAP endpoints. An attacker who can control log messages can execute arbitrary code loaded from a remote server.

exploit.notes: Mass-exploited within 48 hours of disclosure. Trivial one-line payload; scanned for continuously by opportunistic botnets.

steps: Inventory every JVM app on the host for bundled log4j-core jars (including shaded/fat jars).
Upgrade log4j-core to 2.17.1+ and rebuild/redeploy the application.
If an immediate upgrade is impossible, remove the JndiLookup class from the jar as a stopgap: zip -q -d log4j-core-*.jar org/apache/logging/log4j/core/lookup/JndiLookup.class
Restart the JVM service and re-scan to confirm the plugin no longer fires.

CVE-2020-1472.name: Zerologon
CVE-2020-1472.description: An elevation of privilege flaw in the Netlogon Remote Protocol (MS-NRPC). An unauthenticated attacker with network access to a domain controller can set the DC machine account password to an empty value and take over the domain.
CVE-2020-1472.cwe: CWE-330 Use of Insufficiently Random Values
CVE-2020-1472.affected: Windows Server 2008 R2 through 2019 domain controllers

exploit.notes: Public Impacket/Mimikatz modules. Standard step in ransomware domain-takeover playbooks.

remediation.summary: Apply the August 2020 (or later) cumulative update and move DCs to enforcement mode.
steps: Install the August 2020+ Windows cumulative update on every domain controller.
Monitor Event IDs 5827-5831 for legacy devices still using vulnerable Netlogon connections.
Set the FullSecureChannelProtection registry value to 1 (enforcement mode) once the noise is clear.
Reboot the DC and confirm secure channel enforcement.

CVE-2019-0708.name: BlueKeep
CVE-2019-0708.description: A pre-authentication remote code execution vulnerability in Remote Desktop Services. An unauthenticated attacker can send crafted requests over RDP and execute arbitrary code. The flaw is wormable.
CVE-2019-0708.affected: Windows 7, Server 2008, Server 2008 R2 (and XP/2003 out-of-band patch)

exploit.notes: Reliable public Metasploit module. Wormable - a single exposed host puts the whole segment at risk.

remediation.summary: Patch RDP, and require Network Level Authentication in the interim.
steps: Apply the May 2019 RDP security update for the host OS build.
Enable Network Level Authentication (NLA) on Remote Desktop Services - it blocks the pre-auth path.
Restrict TCP/3389 to jump hosts at the firewall; RDP should never be broadly reachable.
Reboot and re-scan.

CVE-2017-0144.name: EternalBlue (MS17-010)
CVE-2017-0144.description: The SMBv1 server in Microsoft Windows mishandles specially crafted packets, allowing remote attackers to execute arbitrary code. Used by the WannaCry and NotPetya worms.

exploit.notes: Shadow Brokers leak. Fully weaponized, wormable, and still the most common lateral-movement path on flat networks.

remediation.summary: Apply MS17-010 and disable SMBv1 entirely.
steps: Apply the MS17-010 security update for the host build.
Disable SMBv1: Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName SMB1Protocol
Confirm no legacy application or scanner/copier depends on SMBv1 before disabling.
Reboot and re-scan.

CVE-2022-22965.name: Spring4Shell
CVE-2022-22965.description: Spring MVC and Spring WebFlux applications running on JDK 9+ are vulnerable to remote code execution via data binding. An attacker can manipulate ClassLoader properties to write a web shell to disk.
CVE-2022-22965.cwe: CWE-94 Improper Control of Generation of Code
CVE-2022-22965.affected: Spring Framework 5.3.0-5.3.17 and 5.2.0-5.2.19 on JDK 9+ deployed as a WAR on Tomcat

exploit.notes: Public exploit drops a JSP web shell in one request. Actively scanned for on internet-facing Tomcat.

remediation.summary: Upgrade Spring Framework to 5.3.18 / 5.2.20 or later.
steps: Upgrade Spring Framework to 5.3.18+ (or 5.2.20+) and Spring Boot to 2.6.6+ / 2.5.12+.
Rebuild and redeploy the WAR.
If the upgrade is blocked, add a ControllerAdvice that blacklists the class.module.classLoader.* binding paths.
Restart Tomcat and verify the exploit path returns 400.

CVE-2017-5638.name: Apache Struts 2 Jakarta Multipart RCE
CVE-2017-5638.description: The Jakarta Multipart parser in Apache Struts 2 mishandles the Content-Type header, allowing remote command execution via a crafted OGNL expression. This is the flaw behind the 2017 Equifax breach.

exploit.notes: Single-header curl exploit. Continuously scanned for; responsible for the Equifax breach of 147M records.

steps: Upgrade Apache Struts to 2.3.32+ or 2.5.10.1+.
If the app is end-of-life, put a WAF rule in front that rejects OGNL expressions in Content-Type as an interim control.
Rebuild, redeploy, and confirm with a benign Content-Type probe.
Review web/app logs for prior exploitation - this CVE is old enough that compromise should be assumed until disproven.

CVE-2019-11043.name: PHP-FPM / nginx env_path_info RCE
CVE-2019-11043.description: An underflow in fpm_main.c allows remote code execution on nginx + PHP-FPM deployments using a particular regex-based fastcgi_split_path_info configuration.

exploit.notes: Public phuip-fpizdam tool exploits this reliably against the default nginx recipe.

remediation.summary: Upgrade PHP and fix the nginx fastcgi_split_path_info regex.
steps: Upgrade PHP to 7.3.11 / 7.2.24 / 7.1.33 or later.
Anchor the nginx regex: fastcgi_split_path_info ^(.+?\.php)(/.*)$; and add try_files $fastcgi_script_name =404;
Reload nginx and restart php-fpm.
Re-scan to confirm.

CVE-2023-4863.name: libwebp heap buffer overflow
CVE-2023-4863.description: A heap buffer overflow in the WebP image decoder (libwebp) allows an attacker to perform an out-of-bounds memory write via a crafted WebP image. Reachable from any application that decodes untrusted images.
CVE-2023-4863.affected: libwebp before 1.3.2 and everything that vendors it (browsers, Electron apps, image pipelines)

exploit.notes: Exploited in the wild as a zero-day in a commercial spyware chain before disclosure.

remediation.summary: Update libwebp to 1.3.2+ and rebuild anything that statically links it.
steps: Update the OS libwebp package to 1.3.2 or later.
Identify applications that statically link or vendor libwebp (Electron apps, Node image tooling, browsers) - the OS package alone does not fix those.
Rebuild or update those applications.
Restart affected services.

CVE-2021-34527.name: PrintNightmare
CVE-2021-34527.description: The Windows Print Spooler service improperly performs privileged file operations, allowing an authenticated remote attacker to run arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges and install drivers.
CVE-2021-34527.affected: All supported Windows versions running the Print Spooler service

exploit.notes: Public Impacket and PowerShell exploits. Common privilege-escalation step after initial access.

remediation.summary: Patch, then disable the Print Spooler anywhere printing is not required.
steps: Apply the July 2021+ cumulative update.
Set the RestrictDriverInstallationToAdministrators registry value to 1.
Disable the Print Spooler service on servers that do not print (domain controllers especially): Stop-Service Spooler; Set-Service Spooler -StartupType Disabled
For POS and kiosk endpoints that DO print, keep the spooler but confirm the driver-install restriction is in force.

CVE-2020-0796.name: SMBGhost
CVE-2020-0796.description: A buffer overflow in the way SMBv3.1.1 handles compressed message requests allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute code on the SMB server. Wormable.
CVE-2020-0796.cwe: CWE-119 Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer
CVE-2020-0796.affected: Windows 10 / Server 1903 and 1909 with SMBv3 compression

exploit.notes: Public RCE and local privilege escalation exploits available.

remediation.summary: Apply KB4551762; disable SMBv3 compression as an interim control.
steps: Apply the March 2020 out-of-band update (KB4551762).
Interim: disable SMBv3 compression - Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanServer\Parameters' DisableCompression -Type DWORD -Value 1 -Force
Block TCP/445 at the branch firewall from anything but the file-server VLAN.
Reboot and re-scan.

CVE-2021-4034.name: PwnKit
CVE-2021-4034.description: A memory corruption flaw in polkit's pkexec utility allows any unprivileged local user to gain full root privileges on a default installation.
CVE-2021-4034.affected: polkit pkexec on essentially every Linux distribution shipped since 2009

exploit.notes: Dozens of reliable public one-file exploits. Default post-exploitation privilege escalation on Linux.

steps: Update polkit via the OS package manager (yum update polkit / apt install --only-upgrade policykit-1).
If patching is blocked, strip the setuid bit as a stopgap: chmod 0755 /usr/bin/pkexec
No reboot required; new logins pick up the fixed binary immediately.
Re-scan to confirm.

CVE-2014-0160.name: Heartbleed
CVE-2014-0160.description: The TLS heartbeat extension in OpenSSL does not validate the payload length, allowing a remote attacker to read up to 64KB of process memory per request - potentially private keys, session tokens, and credentials.

exploit.notes: Trivial, silent, and leaves no application log trace. Any exposure implies possible key and session-token theft.

remediation.summary: Update OpenSSL, then rotate every key and secret the host ever held.
steps: Update OpenSSL to 1.0.1g or later (or rebuild with -DOPENSSL_NO_HEARTBEATS).
Restart every service linked against the old library.
Reissue the TLS certificate with a NEW private key and revoke the old certificate.
Rotate credentials and invalidate all active sessions - assume memory was read.

CVE-2023-44487.name: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset
CVE-2023-44487.description: The HTTP/2 protocol allows a client to rapidly open and cancel streams (RST_STREAM), letting a small number of connections consume disproportionate server resources. Used for record-breaking denial-of-service attacks.
CVE-2023-44487.affected: Most HTTP/2 implementations prior to the October 2023 mitigations (nginx, Apache, Envoy, Netty, Go, .NET)

exploit.notes: Exploited in the wild for 398M rps DDoS. Availability-only impact - no data exposure.

remediation.summary: Update the HTTP/2 server and cap concurrent streams / reset rate.
steps: Update nginx to 1.25.3+ (or the vendor's patched build for your stack).
Set http2_max_concurrent_streams to 128 and keepalive_requests to 1000.
Enable the rapid-reset mitigation at the CDN/WAF edge if one is in front of this host.
Reload the service - no downtime required.

CVE-2018-15473.name: OpenSSH username enumeration
CVE-2018-15473.description: OpenSSH is vulnerable to user enumeration through a timing and response difference when a malformed authentication packet is sent for a non-existent versus an existing user.

exploit.notes: Public Python PoC and a Metasploit auxiliary module. Not RCE - but it is the reconnaissance step that makes credential stuffing against an internet-facing SSH service cheap and quiet.

remediation.summary: Upgrade OpenSSH to 7.8+ and take SSH off the public internet.
steps: Upgrade OpenSSH to 7.8 or later.
Restrict TCP/22 to the jump-host / VPN range - an internet-facing SSH service is the real finding here.
Disable password authentication (PasswordAuthentication no) so enumeration yields nothing usable.
Reload sshd.

CVE-2023-38545.name: curl SOCKS5 heap buffer overflow
CVE-2023-38545.description: A heap buffer overflow in curl's SOCKS5 proxy handshake. When curl is told to use a SOCKS5 proxy with hostname resolution and the hostname exceeds 255 bytes, it can overflow a heap buffer.

exploit.notes: Heavily hyped at disclosure but exploitation requires a very specific configuration: SOCKS5 proxy mode with remote hostname resolution AND attacker control of the target hostname. Rarely reachable in practice.

steps: Update the curl and libcurl packages to 8.4.0+.
Confirm no application on the host uses a SOCKS5 proxy with remote hostname resolution - if none do, the flaw is not reachable and this can ride a normal patch cycle.
Restart long-running processes that link libcurl.
Re-scan.

CVE-2022-0778.name: OpenSSL BN_mod_sqrt infinite loop
CVE-2022-0778.description: The BN_mod_sqrt() function can loop forever on non-prime moduli. Parsing a certificate with a crafted elliptic curve parameter triggers the loop, causing a denial of service.

exploit.notes: PoC certificate available. Denial of service only - no code execution, no data exposure. Only reachable on services that parse client-supplied certificates.

remediation.summary: Update OpenSSL to 1.1.1n / 3.0.2 or later on the next patch cycle.
steps: Update the OpenSSL package to 1.1.1n, 3.0.2, or 1.0.2zd (premium support).
Restart services linked against OpenSSL.
No urgency on an internal build host that does not parse untrusted client certificates - schedule with normal monthly patching.

CVE-2016-2183.name: SWEET32 (64-bit block cipher birthday attack)
CVE-2016-2183.description: DES and Triple DES ciphers used in TLS and SSH have a 64-bit block size, making them vulnerable to a birthday attack that can recover plaintext from a long-lived encrypted session.
CVE-2016-2183.cwe: CWE-327 Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
CVE-2016-2183.affected: Any TLS/SSH endpoint offering 3DES (DES-CBC3-SHA) cipher suites

exploit.notes: Academic. A practical attack needs roughly 785GB of captured traffic within a single keep-alive session. Reported constantly by scanners; almost never a real-world risk. Classic scanner-noise finding.

remediation.summary: Remove 3DES cipher suites from the TLS configuration.
steps: Remove DES/3DES suites from the cipher list (e.g. nginx: ssl_ciphers HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5:!3DES;).
Confirm no legacy client requires 3DES before removing it.
Reload the service.
Bundle this with the next routine TLS hardening change - it does not warrant its own change ticket.
